name: AMC Folder Tab
description: The region is a physical file folder: a trapezoid tab with the icon and title rises from the top edge, and the content sits on a sheet of grained paper tucked into a manila or palette-colored folder, optionally with more sheets peeking out behind it.
useFor: Record-centred regions that read like a file: a customer or supplier Form, a contract or case summary in Static Content, the lines of an order in a Classic Report or Interactive Report, or a small Chart in a dossier page.
helpText: Region template shaped like a file folder. The region title and icon sit on the folder tab; buttons in Help, Edit, Change, Copy, Delete and Create sit beside the tab, and Previous, Close and Next in the paper's footer. The body is a sheet of paper with a light grain and is never clipped or transformed, so report menus, date pickers and popups work normally. Template options: Primary, Success or Danger tab color the whole folder with that palette color and switch the tab text to its contrast color; Stacked papers shows two more sheets peeking out behind the paper; Ink outline gives folder, tab and paper a bold ink border with a hard offset shadow; No body padding lets reports run edge to edge. The tab lifts slightly on hover and focus except under prefers-reduced-motion; forced-colors mode draws plain system borders.

templateOptions.name: Primary tab
templateOptions.help: Folder and tab use the primary palette color; the title switches to the primary contrast color. Without a tab color the folder is manila, mixed from the warning color.

templateOptions.name: Success tab
templateOptions.help: Folder and tab use the success palette color, for approved or closed files.

templateOptions.name: Danger tab
templateOptions.help: Folder and tab use the danger palette color, for escalations and blocked files.

templateOptions.name: Stacked papers
templateOptions.help: Two more sheets peek out at slight angles behind the paper, for files that hold several documents.

templateOptions.name: Ink outline
templateOptions.help: Bold neo-brutal look: 2px ink borders on folder, tab and paper and a hard offset shadow. The ink follows the theme text color, so it inverts in dark styles.

templateOptions.name: No body padding
templateOptions.help: Removes side padding so reports and grids run edge to edge on the paper.
